test_title: PYST 34: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Water likage was thought to be a major cause of landslides.
Water leakage was thought to be a major cause of landslides.
Water leakage was thoght to be a major cause of landslides.
Water leakage was thought to be a major cause of lendslides.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"leakage"** means the accidental admission or escape of a fluid or gas through a hole or crack. (रिसाव)

 
 
• **Example: **The **leakage** in the pipe caused the kitchen to flood.
 
 
 
• **"Thought"** refers to the action or process of thinking. (सोचा गया)
 
 
• **Example: **It was** thought **that the project would be completed by next month.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Likage** (लिकेज): This word is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "leakage".

 
 
• **Example:** The correct term is 'leakage', not 'likage'.
 
 
 
• **Thoght** (थॉट): This word is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "thought".
 
 
• **Example: **The correct term is 'thought', not 'thoght'.
 
 
 
• **Lendslides** (लेंडस्लाइड्स): This word is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "landslides".
 
 
• **Example: **The correct term is 'landslides', not 'lendslides'.

The correct answer is: Option 2.<
